Version 1.0.1 — No file or documentation changes detected.

- No modifications or updates in this release.
- All features, documentation, and workflow remain identical to the previous version.

Gmail Inbox Zero Triage 1.0.0

- Initial release: Achieve Gmail inbox zero quickly with AI-powered batch triage via Telegram.
- Secure OAuth authentication with the gog CLI—no password sharing required.
- AI-generated 1-line summaries help you process all inbox messages (read and unread).
- One-tap Telegram buttons for archiving, filtering, unsubscribing, and viewing emails.
- Fast, queue-based workflow lets you batch actions and execute them instantly.
- Requires gog CLI installed and authenticated; works entirely with standard Python libraries.
